title: spec-review-verdict contract data
description: Reference schema (FAFF-265). The SHAPE of the spec-stage review verdict that FAFF-9's reviewer (FAFF-266), L4 refuters (FAFF-267), and lens-selection (FAFF-268) all map onto. Shape is normative here; the verdict SEMANTICS (which severity implies which verdict) live in the reviewer, not the contract. Fail-loud on a verdict outside the enum (no safe coerce target — faff's own producer emits it). lens/severity are plain strings: their enum is enforced in the compute fn via violations (the prd-readiness.reason precedent), so an echoed bad value never trips a spurious fail-loud. FAFF-935: each objection may additionally carry the OPTIONAL enrichment triple {claim, evidence, predicted_consequence} (plain strings) — additive, never gating; a legacy {lens, severity}-only objection still validates because the triple fields are optional.
